reviews.review:
This game is ok. It has some good qualities: story and setting are unusual; the characters and dialogue are decent; the pixel graphics are charming.

It also has some negative qualities: combat is simplistic (mash sword attack); healing and switching gear i cumbersome; treasure is a hassle to deal with.

I'd probably rate it a thumbs up, barely, but the main thing I cannot forgive is that this game does not respect your time. It forces you to backtrack constantly, with no reliable movement speed increase and far too few warp points. The game also intentionally puts merchants and storage crates much further away form any warp point than necessary. And, as if to rub it in, the game has a very large circular fetch quest which sends you around the entire map _twice_, like a bad joke that you never asked to hear.

I don't respect games that don't respect the player.
